items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I had a trumpet player who could play who could play very good. I'm trying to think, Willy Moore? I believe. I used to turn it over to him, you know, cause if they could handle it better than me, I would let them have it.

ctx.x: And then, so when we got the people, like I said, wanted to hear a beebop number, I had it. See, and so he was a good beebop tenor man.
